defs.def: to bend sth, especially paper or cloth, so that one part lies on top of another part 折叠，对折（纸、织物等）

ex.s: The vehicle — named the Transition – has two seats, four wheels and wings that fold up so it can be driven like a car.
ex.t: 这款名为“Transition”的车辆有两个座位、四个车轮，机翼可以折叠起来，因此可以像汽车一样驾驶。

ex.s: The vehicle-named the Transition – has two seats， four wheels and wings that fold up so it can be driven like a car.
ex.t: 这款名为“Transition”的车辆有两个座位、四个车轮，机翼可以折叠起来，因此可以像汽车一样驾驶。

ex.s: And just look at how her dress is being folded by the wind!
ex.t: 看看她的裙子是如何被风吹得褶皱起来的！
折叠的裙子展现了令人难以置信的____3____。

ex.s: Then he folds the bill and slowly unfolds it again, as if looking at something he can’t believe is there.) Owner: Well, what seems to be the trouble?
ex.t: 然后他折叠钞票，又慢慢展开，好像在看什么他不敢相信的东西。店主：嗯，有什么问题吗？

defs.def: to bend sth so that it becomes smaller or flatter and can be stored or carried more easily; to bend or be able to bend in this way 折小，叠平，可折小，可叠平（以便贮存或携带）

ex.s: These pieces can be folded into a neat little pack and fastened on your belt.
ex.t: 这些衣服可以叠成整齐的小包，扣在腰带上。

ex.s: One of the selling points of this table is its (flexible): you can easily fold it to save space.
ex.t: 这张桌子的卖点之一是它的灵活性：你可以轻松折叠它以节省空间。

defs.def: to wrap sth around sb/sth 包；裹
to close because it is not successful 公司、戏剧等
a part of sth, especially cloth, that is folded or hangs as if it had been folded 褶；褶层；折叠部分
a mark or line made by folding sth, or showing where sth should be folded 褶痕；褶缝；褶线

ex.s: Making an information folder about rescue methods As a class, discuss different rescue methods in natural disasters.
ex.t: 制作关于救援方法的信息文件夹：全班讨论自然灾害中的不同救援方法。

defs.def: an area in a field surrounded by a fence or wall where sheep are kept for safety 羊栏；羊圈
a group of people with whom you feel you belong or who share the same ideas or beliefs 志趣相同的人们；同一信仰的人们
a curve or bend in the line of the layers of rock in the earth's crust （地壳岩石层的）褶皱
a hollow place among hills or mountains 山坳；山洼；山谷
